items.headline: Purdy and the 49ers build a big lead and hold on to beat the Commanders 23-17
items.description: — Brock Purdy and the offense staked San Francisco to a big lead. The defense made sure the 49ers remained undefeated.

items.headline: 49ers hold off furious Commanders' second-half rally to go 6-0
items.description: The 49ers dominated in the first half but had to hold off a second-half Commanders rally.

items.headline: Commanders' Terry McLaurin carted off with knee injury in MNF loss to 49ers
items.description: Terry McLaurin was carted off the field with his left leg in an air cast after injuring his knee against the 49ers. He'll undergo additional testing Tuesday.
